title: Sensitivity to meteorology of regional contributions to air pollution in eastern Canada: part 1: ozone and NOX
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, 6,348-365
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00112A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Robin Stevens, Hélène Côté, Biljana Music, Trevor J. Smith, Patrick L. Hayes
We create emulators to capture the effects of changes in weather on O3 and NOX in eastern Canada. Climate change is projected to increase the US contribution to O3 concentrations in eastern Canada more than the Canadian and Quebec contributions.
